newsitem.title: USA: Gables files for $300 mln in debt/stocks [CORRECTED 19:27 GMT].
newsitem.headline: Gables files for $300 mln in debt/stocks [CORRECTED 19:27 GMT].

text.p: Gables Residential Trust said on Thursday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $300 million in debt securities, preferred and common shares and warrants.

The company said it intends to use the proceeds for general corporate purposes, including repayment of indebtedness, acquisition or investment in new properties and developments and maintenance of currently owned properties.
The real estate investment trust, headquartered in Atlanta, is a manager, developer and owner of multi-family apartment communities in the southeast and southwest.
(Corrects location of company headquarters from Boston, Mass.)
